questions.question: She _______ (has not yet) finished her dissertation, but she hopes to submit it by the end of the month.

If it _______ (rains) tomorrow, we’ll have to cancel the picnic.
She _______ (has been working) here for five years. She’s very experienced now.
They _______ (should not have) left the children alone in the house. It was too dangerous.
She decided to _______ (go) to university after she finished school, even though she didn’t know what she wanted to study.
